description: Stereo input stage for the C1 channel strip, with gain, a high cut, a low cut, phase invert and a switchable meter

params.text: Sets the gain applied to both channels, -60dB to +6dB, slewed at 25Hz so a fast change of gain does not click
Rolls the signal off above the frequency set here, 1kHz to 20kHz at 12dB per octave, and the filter is out of circuit at 20kHz; the panel prints HPF but this knob is the low-pass
Rolls the signal off below the frequency set here, 20Hz to 500Hz at 12dB per octave, and the filter is out of circuit at 20Hz; the panel prints LPF but this knob is the high-pass
Inverts both channels, and lights amber while the inversion is on

inputs.text: The left input, and the source for the right channel as well while the right input is unpatched
The right input; with nothing patched here the left input feeds this channel too

outputs.text: The left channel after the two filters, the phase invert and the gain
The right channel after the two filters, the phase invert and the gain

notes: The three small squares under the meter choose what it shows: RMS, VU with a 300ms decay, or PPM.
The small square at the top right of the meter turns the meter display off; the LED bar graph beside the knobs keeps working.
Each jack carries one channel, so a polyphonic cable is reduced to its first channel.
CHI-X adds voltage control of the gain, both filters and the phase invert, and has to be placed immediately to the right of this module.
The maker's order for the strip is CHAN-IN, SHAPE, C1-EQ, C1-COMP, CHAN-OUT, joined by patch cables rather than by touching.
